activations.reason: On 25 July 2026, a fire started around 9:30 AM near a local school. After firefighters controlled the first outbreak, several new ignition points appeared nearby, leading authorities to suspect it was intentionally set. Strong winds further fueled the flames. Evacuations and lockdowns have affected 18000 people. Emergency services issued Es-Alert warnings across the Plana Baixa region. Multiple towns including la Vilavella, Artana, Eslida, Aín, Alfondeguilla, Tales, and Artesa were evacuated affecting a total of 18 municipalities. Extraordinary resources have been employed (UME) with firefighters, aerial assets, and provincial emergency crews remaining deployed on the scene, focusing on protecting urban areas and stopping the fire from expanding deeper into the Serra d'Espadà natural park. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, wildfire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.

Se han movilizado medios extraordinarios (UME), y permanecen desplegados bomberos, medios aéreos y brigadas provinciales de emergencia, centrados en proteger las zonas urbanas y evitar que el fuego penetre más en el parque natural de la Serra d'Espadà. activations.reason: Due to the rainfall in the Community of Madrid and the provinces of Madrid, Toledo, and Guadalajara since March 8, extraordinary volume situations have occurred in certain reservoirs in the Tajo River basin (mainly Alcorlo, San Juan, Picadas, and Cazalegas reservoirs). This has forced those responsible to carry out extraordinary and high-flow dewatering maneuvers, which have caused the flow rate of the Henares River in the province of Guadalajara, and the Alberche and Tajo rivers, both in the province of Toledo, to rise. The increased flow has affected population centres and agricultural farms adjacent to both rivers, with severe flooding of homes that have forced the authorities to evacuate them. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide initial rough estimation, flood extent, Monitoring and damages assessment emergency mapping.

activations.reasonEs: Debido a las lluvias registradas desde el 8 de marzo en la Comunidad de Madrid y en las provincias de Madrid, Toledo y Guadalajara, se han producido situaciones de volumen extraordinario en algunos embalses de la cuenca del Tajo (principalmente Alcorlo, San Juan, Picadas y Cazalegas). Esto ha obligado a sus responsables a realizar maniobras extraordinarias de desembalse con caudales elevados, que han hecho crecer el caudal del río Henares en la provincia de Guadalajara y de los ríos Alberche y Tajo en la de Toledo. El aumento de caudal ha afectado a núcleos de población y explotaciones agrícolas ribereñas, con inundaciones graves de viviendas que han obligado a las autoridades a evacuarlas. Se solicita a Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping cartografía de emergencia de primera estimación aproximada, extensión de la inundación, monitorización y evaluación de daños.
